notes.title: Support for multiple Keyboard layouts!
notes.content:
Hey ho, typers and shooters! Hope you guys had a great weekend!

We prepared this update over the weekend for you, Neon Ships now support multiple keyboard layouts, yay!!! Being more specific those are the supported layouts:
[list]
[*] QWERTY / QWERTZ
[*] AZERTY
[*] Dvorak
[*] Workman
[*] Colemak
[/list]

Remember that you need to choose your layout on the pause menu! o/

With that, we hope many more players can enjoy our game :3

notes.title: First Feedbacks Already Implemented
notes.content:
You guys gave us some awesome feedback so we already implemented a few of them! Here goes the list, thank you!
[list]
[*][b]Improvement on Screen/Resolution Configuration[/b]: We tried to auto set the player fullscreen configuration, but it was giving a headache to some players, now you can configure the resolution you want windowed or fullscreen!
[*][b]No more punctuation[/b]: Some players with "different" keyboards were having problems typing phrases with punctuation, so we removed it from them!
[*][b]Controls Instructions[/b]: We added a small text explaining the controls to help you know what you have available!
[*][b]Fix: Don't lose letters[/b]: If the player were typing extremely fast two letters could be typed on the same frame, that case we were ignoring one letter. Not anymore, type as fast as you can!!!
[/list]

Thank you a lot for your feedback, hope you guys enjoy the news!
